answer: A workable design: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. An identity earns only when its island recurs, its ledge survives audit, and a lagoon from an unlinked peer confirms it.
